speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are out. You were in it. I am not asking you which name you wore. The yard had a play, and that is the afternoon done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in the gentlemen. I am not naming the part in a tiring-room as if the naming improved it. I am out.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nothing was bought. The K is as I left it. I did not turn a performance into a column. The Rose has a Wise Man this afternoon. You are still in this yard, so you are not in theirs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in theirs. I would like to know how they fill a Wednesday. Liking is not a boat. I am not going.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And you are still courteous, which I shall take as the morning's terms holding for the afternoon. I have no farthings left to offer you. Sam took none, which is a disappointment and a credit to him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the terms. There is no figure, Will. I am not making one out of a play that was not this morning's play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Go and eat something that is not a policy. The stable wall still has my speech in it. I shall fetch it tomorrow if it has not frozen there.
